name: Ibuki Ryuunosuke
source:
The adoptive son of PTA Chairman Serizawa Kamo and classmate of Chizuru, who always eats anpan and milk. Due to being cash-strapped, he makes little earning by being a Jack-of-all-trades in school. He has his own shop at the entrance of the rooftop.

[From [url=http://hakuouki.wikia.com/wiki/Hakuouki_SSL]Hakuouki Wiki[/url]]
